item: /api/insights/status serves the totals at once and runs its two whole-index scans once in the background, carried for ten times their cost
summary: The route was keyed on PRAGMA data_version, which moves on every commit, so during a collection pass every 6 s poll ran count(distinct article_id) and count(id) over the mention index on the request thread with no deadline (audit 0.5.0 A-002; the figures count measured 55 s and 182 s on the 12 M-row field corpus). It now goes through served_cache with a cold payload: articles, keywords and entities answer at once; indexed_articles, remaining and mentions are null with index_counts_state (computing, counted, failed) until a background pass lands; each scan runs under a statement deadline (500 s = 1.6 x the 310 s worst, R220: the field's 182 s count(id) was taken on an ENCRYPTED store; the distinct scan's worst is INFERRED at 255 to 310 s from measured distinct-over-count ratios of 1.2 to 1.7, RC2's SQLCipher re-measure at 12 M and 36 M rows included; only ratios transfer, not its absolute seconds); a finished pair is carried for ten times its measured duration, stamped and disclosed on hover; a failure is held 1,200 s. Measured on a synthetic 12 M-row plaintext index: distinct 2.2 to 2.6 s, count 1.6 to 1.9 s cold. Red without: five mutations each fail a named test. The retired key tests are replaced by tests/test_insights_status_served.py. Field behaviour (a ticker up to about 22 min old at the 55 s count) is inferred and re-measured by RC2.
